title: Marguerite and the Songbook
author: Emrys Blackwood
blurb: Theo Okonkwo, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
